643-5310-6495-6879.description:
Cast Bloodghast by paying {B}{B}.
When Bloodghast enters as an Ally due to Maskwood Nexus, Haru triggers, earthbending a land.
Activate Evereth by sacrificing Bloodghast.
Activate Evereth by sacrificing a land creature.
When the land creature dies, Haru triggers, returning the land from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When the land enters, Bloodghast triggers, returning itself from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Bloodghast enters as an Ally due to Maskwood Nexus, Haru triggers, earthbending a land.
Resolve the Evereth ability from step 4.
Repeat from step 3.
643-5310-6495-6879.notes:
If the chosen land can enter untapped and produce mana, you may do so each iteration to get infinite mana of those color(s) and type(s).
If you have a way to kill Evereth and {1}{B/R} available, you can do so after putting a significant amount of +1/+1 counters on it to deal damage to each opponent using its second ability.

2073-5147-7877-7878.description:
Activate Salvaging Station by tapping it, returning Voyager Glidecar from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Voyager Glidecar enters, it and Kolodin trigger.
Resolve the Voyager Glidecar trigger, causing you to scry 1
Resolve the Kolodin trigger, causing Voyager Glidecar to become an artifact creature until end of turn.
Activate Goblin Bombardment by sacrificing Voyager Glidecar.
When Voyager Glidecar dies, Salvaging Station triggers, untapping Salvaging Station.
Resolve the Goblin Bombardment ability.
Repeat.

1580-4871-5075-5686.description:
Activate Shilgengar by sacrificing Reassembling Skeleton.
When Reassembling Skeleton dies, Pitiless Plunderer and Ogre Slumlord trigger, creating a creature token and a Treasure token.
Resolve the Shilgengar ability.
Activate Shilgengar by sacrificing the creature token.
When the creature token dies, Pitiless Plunderer triggers, creating a Treasure token.
Resolve the Shilgengar ability.
Activate the Treasures by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {1}{B}.
Activate Reassembling Skeleton by paying {1}{B}, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat.

104-671-7690--165.easyPrerequisites: You have a way to gain life.
104-671-7690--165.description:
Gain life.
Cleric Class triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on the other Hero.
Invisible Woman triggers, creating a creature token.
When the creature token enters the battlefield, Daxos triggers, causing you to gain life.
Repeat from step 2.

1894-2173-5220-7452.description:
Activate Bile Urchin by sacrificing it.
When Bile Urchin dies, Mortuary and Cauldron of Essence trigger.
Resolve the Mortuary trigger, putting Bile Urchin from your graveyard onto the top of your library.
Resolve the Cauldron of Essence trigger, causing you to gain 1 life and each opponent to lose 1 life.
Resolve the Bile Urchin ability.
Cast Bile Urchin from the top of your library by paying 1 life.
Repeat.

4934-5078-7356.description:
Cast Sensei's Divining Top by paying {0}.
Longshot triggers, dealing 2 damage to each opponent.
When Sensei's Divining Top enters, Amareth triggers.
Holding priority, activate Sensei's Divining Top's second ability by tapping it, causing you to draw a card and put Sensei's Divining Top from the battlefield onto the top of your library.
Resolve the Amareth trigger, causing you to look at the top card of your library, which will be Sensei's Divining Top, and put it into your hand.
Repeat.

240-1879-3967-5470.description:
Activate Atla by paying {2} and tapping it, creating an 0/1 Egg creature token with defender.
Activate a nontoken creature you control using the ability granted to it by Ghired by tapping it, creating a copy of the Egg token.
Activate Yahenni by sacrificing an Egg token.
When the Egg dies, Atla triggers, causing you to reveal cards from the top of your library until you reveal a creature card and put it onto the battlefield.
Resolve the Yahenni ability, giving Yahenni indestructible until end of turn
Repeat from step 2.

1475-5231-7084.notablePrerequisites: You control another nonland creature with power 1 or greater that does not have One with the Kami attached to it.
1475-5231-7084.description:
Activate Thermopod by sacrificing another nonland creature you control with power 1 or greater.
When the creature dies, Beifong's Bounty Hunters triggers, earthbending a land you control.
Activate Thermopod by sacrificing the earthbent land.
When the land dies, it and One with the Kami trigger.
Resolve the land's trigger, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield tapped.
Resolve the One with the Kami trigger, creating a number of 1/1 Spirit creature tokens equal to the land's power.
Repeat.

1395-2757-3713-5078.description:
Activate Earthcraft by tapping Steelfin Whale, untapping a basic land.
Activate the basic land by tapping it, adding {1}.
Activate Sensei's Divining Top's second ability by tapping it, causing you to draw a card and put Sensei's Divining Top on top of your library.
Cast Sensei's Divining Top from the top of your library by paying {1}.
Elsha's prowess ability triggers, giving it +1/+1 until end of turn.
When Sensei's Divining Top enters, Steelfin Whale triggers, untapping Steelfin Whale.
Repeat.

1497-1829-2173-5220.description:
Activate Wild Cantor by sacrificing it.
When Wild Cantor dies, Mortuary and Vindictive Vampire trigger.
Resolve the Mortuary trigger, putting Wild Cantor from your graveyard onto the top of your library.
Resolve the Vindictive Vampire trigger, causing you to gain 1 life and dealing 1 damage to each opponent.
Cast Wild Cantor from the top of your library by paying 1 life.
Repeat.

uses.battlefieldCardState: attached to another creature you control

178-3259-6791.notablePrerequisites: An opponent cannot block creatures you control.
178-3259-6791.description:
Declare the creature with Breath of Fury attached and Adeline as attackers.
Adeline triggers, creating a creature token.
Deal combat damage using the creature that has Breath of Fury attached. 
Breath of Fury triggers, causing you to sacrifice the creature it is attached to, then attach Breath of Fury to the creature token, then causing you to untap all creatures you control and to get an additional combat phase after this one.
Repeat each combat phase.

1357-2934-4697.easyPrerequisites: You control at least two mana producing permanents, one of which can tap to produce at least {U}.
1357-2934-4697.description:
Cast Howl of the Horde by paying {2}{R}, copying the next instant or sorcery spell you cast.
Cast Reality Spasm by paying at least {3}{U}{U}, targeting at least three permanents and choosing the untap mode.
Howl of the Horde triggers, copying Reality Spasm, targeting at least three permanents.
Holding priority, activate at least two mana-producing permanents you control by tapping them, adding at least {1}{U}.
Activate Errant by paying {1}{U} and tapping it, copying the Reality Spasm copy, targeting Errant and at least two mana-producing permanents you control.
Resolve the copy of Reality Spasm from step 3, untapping Errant and at least two mana-producing permanents you control.
Repeat from step 4.
1357-2934-4697.notes: It is recommended to pay at least {1} extra when casting Reality Spasm initially. If you choose not to, you will not get infinite untap of permanents or mana from those permanents, unless one of the mana-producing permanents taps to produce two or more mana.

uses.n: Ojer Taq, Deepest Foundation // Temple of Civilization

1270-1563-2457-6633.description:
Activate Ant Queen by paying {1}{G}, creating three 1/1 Insect creature tokens.
Activate two Insects by tapping them, adding {G}{G}.
Repeat

1287-2397-6318.easyPrerequisites: You have either {4}{U}{U} or eight {E} available.
1287-2397-6318.description:
Cast Aethertide Whale by paying eight {E} if able or {4}{U}{U} otherwise.
When Aethertide Whale enters the battlefield, it triggers twice, causing you to get twelve {E}.
Activate Aethertide Whale by paying {E}{E}{E}{E}, returning it from the battlefield to your hand.
Repeat.

186-3525-4720-5516.notablePrerequisites:
An opponent controls a creature.
Red Death does not have summoning sickness.
Pemmin's Aura attached to Red Death.
186-3525-4720-5516.description:
Activate Red Death by tapping it, adding {R}, goading a creature an opponent controls and causing that opponent to draw a card.
Activate Stonework Packbeast by paying {1}, adding {U}.
Activate Pemmin's Aura by paying {U}, untapping Red Death.
Repeat.

222-527-1849-2511.notablePrerequisites:
You control a creature with power 5 or greater.
You control a Saproling.
222-527-1849-2511.description:
Activate Selvala by paying {G} and tapping it, adding at least {1}{B}{R}{G}{G}.
Activate Bloodflow Connoisseur twice by sacrificing Slimefoot and Squee and Selvala.
Activate Slimefoot and Squee by paying {1}{B}{R}{G} and sacrificing a Saproling, returning it and Selvala from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Slimefoot and Squee enters the battlefield, it triggers, creating a 1/1 Saproling creature token.
Repeat.

957-2061-2239.notablePrerequisites: You have enough mana to cast Time Stretch each other turn.
957-2061-2239.description:
Cast Time Stretch by paying its mana cost, causing you to take two extra turns after this one.
Move to your next turn.
At the beginning of your upkeep, Extravagant Replication triggers, creating a token copy of Ardent Elementalist.
When the Ardent Elementalist token enters the battlefield, it triggers, returning Time Stretch from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat during your second extra turn.

2438-2773-4133.description:
Cast Soul Collector by paying {3}{B}{B}.
When Soul Collector enters the battlefield, Warstorm Surge triggers, causing Soul Collector to deal damage to itself equal to its power.
If an ability from Carrion Feeder is waiting to resolve, let it resolve.
Activate Carrion Feeder by sacrificing Soul Collector.
When Soul Collector dies, it triggers, returning itself from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat from step 2.

659-4381-4613-4885.notablePrerequisites: You control a creature with a +1/+1 counter on it.
659-4381-4613-4885.description:
Activate a creature with a +1/+1 counter on it, creating a 1/1 red Goblin creature token.
The 1/1 Goblin token enters with a +1/+1 counter on it due to Grumgully's ability.
Repeat.

1379-4659-5267-5351.notablePrerequisites: You control at least one additional nonland permanent.
1379-4659-5267-5351.description:
Activate Krark-Clan Ironworks by sacrificing another nonland permanent, adding {C}{C}.
Because the permanent is a Clue artifact due to Encroaching Mycosynth and Senator Peacock, Ulvenwald Mysteries' second ability triggers, creating a 1/1 Human Soldier creature token that is also a Clue artifact.
Repeat.
Once you have infinite mana, you may instead sacrifice the Human Soldiers to their own abilities to draw infinite cards.

1283-2825-3525-4036.notablePrerequisites:
Pemmin's Aura attached to Elite Arcanist.
Elite Arcanist does not have summoning sickness.
1283-2825-3525-4036.description:
Activate Elite Arcanist's ability by paying {3} and tapping it, casting a copy of Seething Song without paying its mana cost.
Resolve Seething Song, adding {5}.
Activate Pemmin's Aura's first ability by paying {1}, untapping Elite Arcanist.
Repeat.

722-3153-3908.description:
Cast Chronomantic Escape by paying {4}{W}{W}, causing creatures to be unable to attack you until your next turn, and exiling Chronomantic Escape with three time counters on it.
At the beginning of your postcombat main phase, Sphinx of the Second Sun and Spark Double each trigger, causing you to get two additional beginning phases after this phase.
Move to your first additional beginning phase.
At the beginning of your upkeep, Chronomantic Escape triggers, removing a time counter from itself.
Repeat from step 3 one additional time.
At the beginning of your next upkeep, Chronomantic Escape triggers, removing a time counter from itself and causing you to cast it without paying its mana cost.
Resolve Chronomantic Escape,  causing creatures to be unable to attack you until your next turn, and exiling Chronomantic Escape with three time counters on it.
Repeat from step 2.

496-970-4774-4893-5112.description:
Activate Mairsil using Asmodeus' first ability by paying {B}{B}{B}, causing you to draw seven cards.
Activate Mairsil using Pack Rat's ability by paying {B} and discarding a card.
Holding priority, activate Mairsil by discarding a card and sacrificing it, adding {B}{B}{B}.
Resolve the Mairsil ability from step 2, creating a token copy of Mairsil.
Repeat from step 2 one additional time.
Repeat from step 1.

1519-2178-4283-4680.notablePrerequisites:
Whisper does not have summoning sickness.
Thornbite Staff attached to Whisper.
You have a creature card in your graveyard.
You control at least one additional creature.
1519-2178-4283-4680.description:
Activate Whisper by tapping it and sacrificing Gulping Scraptrap and another creature.
When the creatures die, Gulping Scraptrap triggers once and Whisper triggers twice.
Resolve the Whisper triggers, untapping it.
Resolve the Gulping Scraptrap trigger, causing you to proliferate.
Venser triggers, creating a legendary 3/3 Hollow Sentinel artifact creature token.
Resolve the Whisper ability from step 1, returning a creature card from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Activate Whisper by tapping it and sacrificing The Hollow Sentinel and another creature you control.
When the creatures die, Whisper triggers twice, untapping Whisper.
Resolve the Whisper ability from step 7, returning Gulping Scraptrap from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Gulping Scraptrap enters the battlefield, it triggers,  causing you to proliferate.
Venser triggers, creating a legendary 3/3 Hollow Sentinel artifact creature token.
Repeat.

400-1947-4763.notablePrerequisites: Stormrider Rig attached to Reckless Barbarian.
400-1947-4763.description:
Activate Reckless Barbarian by sacrificing it, adding {R}{R}.
When Reckless Barbarian dies, Koll triggers, returning Reckless Barbarian from your graveyard to your hand.
Cast Reckless Barbarian by paying {1}{R}.
When Reckless Barbarian enters the battlefield, Stormrider Rig triggers, attaching itself to Reckless Barbarian.
Repeat.

1670-2534-5256.notablePrerequisites: Pulsemage Advocate does not have summoning sickness.
1670-2534-5256.description:
Activate Altar of Dementia by sacrificing Coercive Recruiter, causing target opponent to mill cards equal to Coercive Recruiter's power.
Activate Pulsemage Advocate by tapping it and putting three cards from an opponent's graveyard into their owner's hand, returning Coercive Recruiter from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Coercive Recruiter enters the battlefield, untapping Pulsemage Advocate.
Repeat.

1283-2232-2440-3426.description:
Activate Chromatic Orrery's first ability by tapping it, adding {5}.
Cast Deranged Hermit by paying {5}.
Deranged Hermit enters the battlefield, triggering itself, Cloudstone Curio, and Mana Echoes.
Resolve the Cloudstone Curio trigger, returning nothing to your hand from the battlefield.
Resolve the Deranged Hermit trigger, creating four 1/1 Squirrel creature tokens.
The Squirrels enter the battlefield, triggering Mana Echoes four times and Cloudstone Curio four times.
Resolve the first Cloudstone Curio trigger, returning Deranged Hermit from the battlefield to your hand.
Resolve all remaining Cloudstone Curio triggers, returning nothing to your hand from the battlefield.
Resolve all Mana Echoes triggers, adding {4} for each Squirrel you control, plus {1} for each Elf you control.
Repeat from step 2.

914-2234-3094-4191.notablePrerequisites: Opponents control at least four artifacts and/or enchantments.
914-2234-3094-4191.description:
Cast Baral's Expertise by paying {3}{U}{U}.
Holding priority, activate Lithoform Engine's second ability by paying {3} and tapping it, copying Baral's Expertise.
Resolve the copy of Baral's Expertise, returning Dockside Extortionist and Lithoform Engine from the battlefield to your hand, and casting Lithoform Engine from your hand without paying its mana cost.
Cast Dockside Extortionist by paying {0}.
Dockside Extortionist enters the battlefield, creating at least four Treasure tokens.
Activate three Treasure tokens by tapping and sacrificing those, adding three mana of any color.
Repeat from step 2.

1870-3316-4873.notablePrerequisites: You have at least twenty life.
1870-3316-4873.description:
Cast Eternity Vessel.
Cast Dismantle targeting Eternity Vessel, destroying it and placing an amount of counters on Darksteel Reactor equal to the number of charge counters that were on Eternity Vessel.
Darksteel Reactor triggers, winning you the game.

2034-2730-5237.easyPrerequisites: You had a permanent leave the battlefield this turn.
2034-2730-5237.description:
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing Renegade Rallier.
When Renegade Rallier dies, Kaya's Ghostform triggers, returning Renegade Rallier from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Renegade Rallier enters, it triggers, returning Kaya's Ghostform from your graveyard to the battlefield attached to Renegade Rallier
Repeat.

2302-4215-5229-5256.description:
Activate Altar of Dementia by sacrificing Ulamog.
Ulamog and Verdant Succession trigger.
Resolve the Ulamog trigger, shuffling your graveyard into your library.
Resolve the Verdant Succession trigger, searching your library for Ulamog, putting it onto the battlefield and shuffling your library.
Resolve the Altar of Dementia ability from step 1, causing target player to mill cards equal to Ulamog's power.
Repeat.

981-1517-1532-2104.notablePrerequisites: The Mirari Conjecture has two lore counters on it.
981-1517-1532-2104.description:
At the beginning of your precombat main phase, The Mirari Conjecture triggers, putting a lore counter on itself, sacrificing itself and copying all instant and sorcery spells you cast this turn.
Cast Temporal Manipulation by paying {3}{U}{U}.
The Mirari Conjecture triggers, creating a copy of Temporal Manipulation.
Resolve both Temporal Manipulations, getting two extra turns after this one.
Cast Faith's Reward by paying {3}{W}.
The Mirari Conjecture triggers, copying Faith's Reward.
Holding priority, activate Cursecatcher by sacrificing it, countering the original Faith's Reward.
Resolve the Faith's Reward copy, returning The Mirari Conjecture and Cursecatcher from your graveyard to the battlefield.
The Mirari Conjecture triggers, putting a lore counter on itself and returning Faith's Reward from your graveyard to your hand.
Proceed to your next turn.
At the beginning of your precombat main phase, The Mirari Conjecture triggers, putting a lore counter on itself and returning Temporal Manipulation from your graveyard to your hand.
Proceed to your next turn.
Repeat.
